description:
1 & 7 Speed Lowrider Beach Cruiser Bike for Women
The Tracer Taha Complete Cruiser Bike for Women combines style and performance with its 26-inch wheels, durable Hi-Ten steel frame, and Shimano 1/7-speed options. This hybrid bike is perfect for cruising the beach or commuting, featuring fat tires for added stability and comfort. Available in multiple colors, it offers a smooth and relaxed ride for adult women. Whether you're riding for leisure or daily use, the Tracer Taha delivers both function and fashion in one bike.
Notice: Saddle and handbar grips have brown, black and white，shipped randomly！If you want to Specify the color for the grips and saddle, please leave a note.

EASIER RIDING: The TRACER TAHA beach cruiser is built for your comfort and relaxation. 26"×2.125" Inch Wheels, adult bicycle tires, enough to meet different kinds of rolling, whether a casual riding with families, friends, or for commuting use. You get to choose two-toned color options that suit your personality.
SAFER RIDING: The Stunning TAHA beach cruiser demonstrates some of the professional components like alloy seat post, coaster brakes, stainless steel spokes, 26’’X2.125” whitewall tires, and colored fenders.
HIGH QUALITY: High-quality sealed ISO bottom bracket with CrMo square axle and bearing shells of wrought iron, Hi-Ten Steel Frame, and Stainless Steel 14G Spokes.
COMFORT DESIGN: Wide cruiser bar, soft tower cruiser seat with a springer, fully stretch your body and arms, making the riding comfortable.
EASY INSTALLATION: Fits riders from 5 feet to 6 feet 2 inches tall; comes 85 percent assembled.

EXTRAS

WEIGHT

The most accurate way to determine any bike’s weight is to have your local dealer weigh it for you. Many brands strive to list the lowest possible weight, but in reality weight can vary based on size, finish, hardware and accessories. All our bikes are designed for best-in-class weight and ride quality.
